from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
root=Path.cwd()
d=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1'
assert not d.exists(),'E5来源探针已存在，不覆盖'
d.mkdir()
stamp=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
protocol={
 'study_id':'510300_TREASURY_DEALER_EXPECTATION_SOURCE_PROBE_V1','experiment_id':'E5_SOURCE_PROBE',
 'registered_at':stamp,'question':'财政部2023年第四季度Primary Dealer Auction Size Survey是否公开了事前规模预测的已填回答/分布及其时点，能否与11月季度计划匹配？',
 'phase':'ONE_FIXED_SURVEY_SOURCE_PROBE_NO_RETURNS',
 'prior_navigation_disclosure':'已浏览官方目录，发现2015—2025每年只列Q2/Q4链接；目录不是四季完整样本，也尚未确认文件是问卷、结果、建议或后来预测。',
 'fixed_source':{'catalog_url':'https://home.treasury.gov/policy-issues/financing-the-government/quarterly-refunding/quarterly-refunding-archives/primary-dealer-auction-size-survey','year':2023,'quarter_label':'4th Quarter','file_selection':'官方目录2023项下4th Quarter唯一链接','max_files':1,'max_pdf_pages':20,'attempts_per_url':2,'max_other_documents':0},
 'checks':['文件的真实类别和标题，不将问卷、TBAC建议当机构预测分布','答卷回收期与公布期、预测季度和实际财政安排匹配','缺已填数值/公布证据则结束该来源路线，不自行填调查结果','机构预测不能自动等于全市场共识或外生冲击'],
 'no_month_or_document_selection_by_returns':True,
 'source_qualified_is_not_prediction_edge':True,
 'new_stock_returns_loaded':False,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_code_edits':0,
 'goal_achieved':False,'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,
}
p=d/'protocol.json'
p.write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
prior=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1/result.json'
freeze={'registered_at':stamp,'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'before_survey_file_fields':True,'before_new_stock_returns_or_score':True,
 'input_hashes':{str(prior.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'):hashlib.sha256(prior.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}}
(d/'freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('E5已登记：只核对2023目录Q4的一个文件，不评分。')
